4: struct ringbuf {
5:     uint8_t *data;
6:     size_t capacity;
7:     size_t head;         /* index of next byte to read (oldest) */
8:     size_t tail;         /* index of next free slot (newest+1) */
9:     size_t count;        /* bytes currently stored in the buffer */
10: };
11: 
12: ringbuf_t *rb_create(size_t capacity)
13: {
14:     ringbuf_t *rb;
15: 
16:     if (capacity == 0)
17:         return NULL;
18: 
19:     rb = malloc(sizeof(*rb));
20:     if (!rb)
21:         return NULL;
22: 
23:     rb->data = malloc(capacity);
24:     if (!rb->data) {
25:         free(rb);
26:         return NULL;
27:     }
28: 
29:     rb->capacity   = capacity;
30:     rb->head       = 0;
31:     rb->tail       = 0;
32:     rb->count      = 0;
33:     return rb;
34: }
35: 
36: void rb_destroy(ringbuf_t *rb)
37: {

39:         return;
40:     free(rb->data);
41:     free(rb);
42: }

45: {

47: 
48:     if (!rb || !data || len == 0)
49:         return 0;
50: 
51:     n = len;
52:     if (n > rb->capacity - rb->count)
53:         n = rb->capacity - rb->count;
54: 
55:     for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
56:         rb->data[rb->tail] = data[i];
57:         rb->tail++;
58:         if (rb->tail == rb->capacity)

60:     }
61:     rb->count += n;
62:     return n;
63: }

68:

75:

77:         out[i] = rb->data[rb->head];
78:         rb->head++;

81:     }
82:     rb->count -= n;

part.text:
All compiled cleanly with `-Wall -Werror` and every test passed. Here's a summary of the implementation:

### `ringbuf.c` — design choices

| Detail | Approach |
|---|---|
| **Storage** | Flat `uint8_t*` allocated in `rb_create()` |
| **Position tracking** | Three counters on the side: `head`, `tail`, `count` — no complex modulo math at runtime |
| **Wrapping** | When `tail`/`head` reaches `capacity` it resets to 0 (circular pointer) |
| **Partial writes** | Stores what fits (`min(requested, capacity - count)`) and returns that count |
| **Reads empty buffer** | Resets both `head` and `tail` to 0 on drain — keeps invariants tidy |
| **NULL-safety** | Every function handles `rb == NULL` and argument == NULL gracefully |

### Files created
- **`ringbuf.c`** — full implementation of all 8 functions declared in the header
- **`test.c`** — smoke test covering: lifecycle, FIFO order, overflow wrap-around, partial writes, peek, clear, NULL handling, and 100 round-trip stress checks
